verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions that POS extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API and that POS UI extension API docs exist. Nothing documents a downloadable machine-readable spec, such as an OpenAPI file or a published GraphQL schema. The llms.txt probe is a documentation guide for AI crawlers, not an API specification, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
